_summary: 21 requirements from spec 26_32_13_engine_generators_ALPHA.pdf; need on site 2027-10-04

schedule_row.notes: Power block A; outdoor sound-attenuated enclosure

requirements.requirement: Generator set continuous standby capacity shall meet the scheduled rating of 2000 kW and 2500 kVA at 0.8 PF.

spec_citation.quote: shall be rated for the continuous standby capacity (kW and kVA at 0.8 PF) and output amperes scheduled on Drawing E-601

requirements.requirement: Generator set output shall be 480Y/277 V, 3-phase, 4-wire, 60 Hz power.

spec_citation.quote: while generating 480Y/277 volt, 3-phase, 4-wire, 60 Hz power, and with performance as specified herein.

requirements.requirement: Motor starting capability shall be not less than 3000 kVA with a maximum voltage dip of 30% for 2000 kW sets.

spec_citation.quote: shall be capable of developing not less than 3000 kVA (2000 kW sets) and 1500 kVA (1000 kW sets) for motor starting with a maximum voltage dip of 30%

requirements.requirement: Excitation power to the automatic voltage regulator shall be provided by a permanent magnet generator (PMG) or equal.

spec_citation.quote: A permanent magnet generator (PMG) or equal shall provide excitation power to the automatic voltage regulator

requirements.requirement: Engine shall be an 8, 12, or 16 cylinder, 4-cycle diesel engine, either turbocharged/aftercooled or normally aspirated.

spec_citation.quote: Engine shall be an 8, 12, or 16 cylinder, 4 cycle, turbocharged/aftercooled or normally aspirated fuel injected full diesel engine

requirements.requirement: Governor shall be electronic speed-sensing capable of isochronous frequency regulation from no load to full rated load.

spec_citation.quote: electronic speed-sensing governor capable of isochronous frequency regulation from no load to full rated load.

requirements.requirement: Starting system shall be 24 volt, 2-wire, negative ground, gear engaging electric starter.

spec_citation.quote: Starting System: Remote 24 volt, 2-wire, negative ground, starting system, positive shift, gear engaging electric starter

requirements.requirement: Average fuel consumption at full standby load must not exceed 145 gph for a 2000 kW set.

spec_citation.quote: Average fuel consumption at full standby load shall not exceed 145 gph for 2000 kW sets

requirements.requirement: Unit-mounted radiator cooling system sized to maintain safe operation at 122°F maximum ambient temperature.

spec_citation.quote: cooling system shall be unit mounted radiator cooled

requirements.requirement: Engine emissions compliance with applicable EPA Tier levels for non-road engines.

spec_citation.quote: comply with all applicable EPA Tier Levels for Non-Road Engines

requirements.requirement: Operate at ambient conditions of 300 ft altitude and 10 to 122°F ambient temperature.

spec_citation.quote: Ambient conditions of 300' altitude and an ambient temperature of 10 to 122°F.

requirements.requirement: Engine speed shall not exceed 1800 rpm.

spec_citation.quote: rpm of the engine shall not exceed 1800 rpm

requirements.requirement: Generator shall be 4-pole, brushless, and two-thirds pitch wound.

spec_citation.quote: Generator shall be 4-pole, revolving field type, brushless, dynamically balanced, skewed laminated, two thirds pitch wound

requirements.requirement: Generator insulation shall be NEMA Class F or better.

spec_citation.quote: NEMA Class F or better insulation as defined by NEMA MG1.65.

requirements.requirement: Provide a 120 V, single-phase space heater to prevent condensation in the generator.

spec_citation.quote: A 120 volt, single phase space heater shall be provided to prevent condensation in the generator.

requirements.requirement: Provide 3-pole generator output circuit breaker(s) with solid-state trip units.

spec_citation.quote: Generator set shall have 3 pole output circuit breaker(s) with solid state trip units as shown on the drawings.

requirements.requirement: Maintain voltage regulation within plus 2% from no load to rated load.

spec_citation.quote: Voltage Regulation: Plus 2% no load to rated load; rheostat for _5% voltage adjustment.

requirements.requirement: Total harmonic distortion of ac voltage waveform from no load to full linear load shall not exceed 5% of rated voltage.

spec_citation.quote: The sum of ac voltage waveform harmonies, from no load to full linear load shall not exceed 5% of the rated voltage

requirements.requirement: Provide a UL 2085 listed in-skid fuel tank with usable capacity for at least 24 hours of operation at full standby load.

spec_citation.quote: provided with a UL 2085 listed manufacturer's standard in skid fuel transfer day tank. The tank shall have usable capacity for not less than 24 hours of operation at full standby load,

requirements.requirement: Provide two 5000 W, 480 V, 1-phase jacket-water heaters.

spec_citation.quote: engine shall have two KIM #Hotstart (480 volt, 1-phase) or approved equal, 5000W jacket-water heaters supplied from a "normal" branch circuit.

requirements.requirement: Provide a weatherproof and rodent-proof outdoor enclosure entirely enclosing the generator set, with silencers installed inside.

spec_citation.quote: Provide a weatherproof and rodent-proof outdoor shelter to entirely enclose each generator set, including batteries. Silencers shall be installed inside enclosure.
